data.name: Turbo Bullets: World In Havoc
data.detailed_description:
⭐ ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST AND FOLLOW OUR ROAD TO KICKSTARTER (EST. 25/09/2026)

Turbo Bullets in a Nutshell

  • Dynamic Car Combat inspired by Death Rally and Twisted Metal series

  • A wild, intriguing Texas‑inspired open world, fully hand‑crafted and spanning 16 km² map

    (twice the size of Fallout 4 playable map)

  • Advanced physics with stamina‑based object carrying — lift, drag, roll and transport items until your strength runs out

  • Gathering and Crafting — collect scrap, refine it into resources, earn money by helping the local community, buy upgrades, start missions

  • An abstract, humorous story full of twists

  • 30+ playable vehicles planned

  • A unique, satisfying ground‑to‑air‑to‑ground rocket combat system with real‑time enemy missile warnings and visualization

FROM DUSTY TEXAS SCRAPYARDS TO GLOBAL DEATH ARENAS —

A STORY THAT SHOULD NEVER HAVE HAPPENED

It’s early in the morning. You wake up, struggling to breathe — you pull a thick bag off your head. Your skull and wrists feel like they’re about to explode. You put on your shoes and push the door open… Blinding sunlight floods your hideout, and the hot Texas morning air punches you in the chest — THEY… REALLY DID IT! They actually left you alone in the middle of nowhere… somewhere in Texas.

A TEXAS SCRAP COLLECTOR WORKING UNDERCOVER, FIGHTING AND COMPLETING MISSIONS AROUND THE WORLD

Now it’s time to find your missing mechanic, prepare your ride for combat and ruin mafia’s plans. You have 30 days to accomplish something meaningful — otherwise the police will tear up the deal, and you won’t be laughing.

When you signed the documents, you imagined alarms blaring, lights shutting off, and a metal capsule descending from the ceiling with your name on it. A sports car, a set of gadgets, and specialists analyzing your every move on wall‑sized screens — just like in those British spy movies where technology shines and engineers in perfectly ironed suits work in labs filled with equipment that shouldn’t exist yet.

Then reality hits — along with a 97.9% budget cut “from above”.

You end up in Dry Pants. A small, post‑industrial town somewhere in Texas. A place that looks like God forgot to finish it and then said: “Meh, let's leave it like that…”. Hope left this town long ago on the first available bus. In Dry Pants you don’t live; in Dry Pants — you exist.

Gus’s Giant Steel Recycling Center and the military base to the west are the only places still operating after the chemical incident at Chemi‑Trails Plant— a place that theoretically shouldn’t have exploded… theoretically.

The locals are a mix of hustlers, tricksters and slackers living off whatever’s illegal or off Uncle Sam’s welfare checks. Nobody works too hard here, and one wrong word can cost you your teeth.

🌵 OPEN WORLD

Turbo Bullets: World In Havoc is likely the first sandbox game set in a Texas‑inspired open world — a place wild, intriguing and full of character.

It blends exploration of the fictional town of Dry Pants with global action missions and races, creating a unique mix of freedom, chaos, humor and adrenaline.

A world that lives on its own — full of scrapyards, trailer parks, wastelands, wind farms, old military bases and people who never play fair.

🔥 COMBAT MODE / MISSIONS

Starting a mission is pure madness. Use your custom‑built vehicle and throw yourself into battle — ram, shoot, flip opponents, destroy them before the race ends or reach the finish line first.

You’re sitting in a 4‑ton chariot of death, so jokes aside — go unleash hell.

🎮 GAMEPLAY: EXPLORE, COLLECT, TRANSPORT, UPGRADE, WIN, EARN

Race on dangerous tracks and shoot your opponents, or simply reach the finish line. Win races and complete missions to earn rewards, spend money on deadlier weapons and upgrades.

Visit dystopian wastelands, icy glaciers, forgotten prisons and breathtaking islands.

Roam the Texas wasteland to gather unique items and prepare your ride for missions.

Send opponents to the scrapyard of history — timing and reflexes matter.

Plant mines, drop bombs, fire mortars, cannons and rockets (and more!). Use crazy weapons like the Scrap Thrower to push enemies off cliffs or show them who’s boss and blast their asses off.

🧠 CHOOSE YOUR STRATEGY TO WIN

Go all‑in and smash your way to the finish line, or use shortcuts and spectacular jumps to save precious seconds. Push enemies into explosive barrels or rain deadly fire from guard towers. Use the Scrap Thrower to send rivals flying off cliffs — the road to victory is yours to choose.

⚙️ PROVEN GAMEPLAY MECHANICS

We love tried‑and‑true mechanics, so many come from classics you already adore. Earn money to buy faster and stronger cars, and spend your cash creating the best equipment combinations to wipe opponents off the track.

💀 THE LETHAL TOURNAMENT

Held in the shadows of shady deals — illegal races with no rules. Everything and everyone wants you dead. Even heavily armed police will try to take you down — you’re undercover, they don’t know you’re on their side.

Avoid traps and deadly turrets, win races and duels, climb the career ladder and buy faster, stronger cars. Upgrade your vehicle and acquire modern weapons to scrap your enemies, in these insane races, tactics and planning are key.

🔫 WEAPONS

Machine Gun Your best friend. Turn enemies into Swiss cheese and send them straight to the scrapyard.

Homing Missile Launcher Limited ammo, massive destruction. Wait for the right moment, fire, and watch chaos unfold.

Mortar Old but deadly. A direct hit turns even the toughest opponent into a flaming pile of scrap.

Anti‑Tank Cannon The name says it all. When you find ammo for this beast, enemies will beg for mercy.

Bomb Drop it behind your vehicle and watch the rear camera as it wipes enemies off the track like a giant bowling ball.

Land Mine Precise and deadly. A well‑placed mine becomes an invisible executioner.

Minigun (Gatling Gun) Upgrade your machine gun and drown enemies in a storm of bullets.

Swap Gun A direct hit swaps your position with the target. Just don’t swap when the enemy is speeding straight into explosive barrels…

This weapon is absolutely insane.

🎭 STORY

You’re waiting in the parking lot for your father when suddenly your life flips upside down — a wounded gang leader jumps into your car and orders you to drive.

Hours later, counter‑terrorists storm your home. You get an offer you can’t refuse — the prosecutor will drop the charges if you become a police informant.

You’re dumped somewhere in the Texas wasteland and then forced to participate in a series of deadly races known as the Lethal Tournament, infiltrate the criminal group led by the dangerous Mr. Clutch, and discover who’s truly behind the event.

🛠️ EARLY ACCESS

The Early Access version is planned to include:

  • A exploration of massive, Texas‑inspired 16 km² hand‑crafted open world 

  • 5 diverse race maps across the globe — wastelands, icy glaciers, toxic rural zones, urban construction sites and breathtaking islands

  • Tournament mode

  • Local split‑screen multiplayer — up to 4 players at once

data.short_description: Explore a Texas-inspired world, gather resources, transport them, hunt for uniques, repair and arm your combat vehicle to prove your worth in a series of deadly global missions. A unique mix of first-person open-world survival and racing with combat.

  • OS *: Windows 7, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 / Intel i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6000 MB available space
